title: Customer-Pay Repairs Repair Order Terms: Drop-Off, Deposit and Start of Work
content:
**Customer-Pay Repairs - drop-off and deposit.**

(a) Work starts when the vehicle is dropped off; the drop-off date is the start date, and the repair order moves from opened to in repair.

(b) When the quoted total is at or above the tier's deposit threshold, a deposit of the tier's deposit percentage of the quoted total, rounded to the cent, is taken at drop-off as a payment of kind deposit; fleet accounts pay no deposit and are invoiced on the tier's fleet payment terms.

(c) Where the tier orders parts only after the deposit, parts are ordered only after the deposit is received.

(d) Where a deposit is due, it is received before parts are ordered.

(e) The quoted work charge posts on the start date.

(f) The ready notice is targeted within the tier's target turnaround in business days, same-day only where the tier offers same-day service.

## Condition on ordering parts

> Where a deposit is due, it is received before parts are ordered.

It is decided from the repair order's own ledger: a payment of kind deposit recorded on that repair order, as the system shows it before the parts order is placed.

| Deposit due on the order | Deposit payment on the order's ledger | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Met |
| Yes | No | Not met: parts are not ordered |
| No (quoted total below the threshold, or a fleet account) | - | Places no requirement |

## Deposit amounts (hypothetical quoted totals; percentages and thresholds from the Customer-Pay Repairs terms schedule)

| Tier (deposit percentage, threshold) | Customer | Quoted total | Deposit at drop-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Panel Repair Service (30 percent, 500.00) | individual | 1250.00 | 375.00 |
| Panel Repair Service (30 percent, 500.00) | individual | 500.00 | 150.00 (at the threshold) |
| Panel Repair Service (30 percent, 500.00) | individual | 499.99 | none (below the threshold) |
| Bumper Refinish Service (25 percent, 500.00) | individual | 1234.56 | 308.64 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service (50 percent, 1000.00) | individual | 2345.66 | 1172.83 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service (50 percent, 1000.00) | fleet account | 4000.00 | none; invoiced on the fleet payment terms |

The deposit is computed on the quoted total, the same total that is compared with the threshold.
